meta.title: About us
meta.description: A Luxembourg cleaning company built on consistency, confidentiality and care, serving residences and institutions across the Grand Duchy.

hero.title: Care you can rely on, discretion you never have to ask for
hero.intro: For [XX] years we have looked after private residences, offices and institutions across Luxembourg, quietly and to the same exacting standard every time.

image.alt: A gloved hand polishing a mirror with a sponge

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: [Placeholder: founding story. Who started the company, when and why. Two or three sentences in the owner's own words.]
From the beginning, we chose to grow slowly and to work with the same people for many years. That continuity is what our clients notice first: they know who will come, when, and what will be done.

Today our teams serve households in Belair, Limpertsberg and Strassen as well as offices in Kirchberg, Cloche d'Or and the Gare district. Some of our clients are among the country's most security-conscious institutions.

items.title: Consistency
items.body: The same vetted cleaner, on the same day and at the same time, for every recurring client.

items.title: Confidentiality
items.body: What we see and hear stays with us. Confidentiality agreements are available for every engagement.

items.title: Reliability
items.body: Cover is arranged in advance for holidays and absences, so your service never simply stops.

items.title: Responsibility
items.body: Eco-responsible products and methods, chosen to protect your surfaces, your health and the environment.

standards.title: Selected with care, trained to our standard
standards.intro: Clients let us into their homes and offices. That trust starts with how we choose and support our team.

items.title: Rigorous selection
items.body: References, interviews and a criminal record extract (bulletin n° 3) for every team member.

items.title: In-house training
items.body: Surface care, products, safety, and the etiquette expected in private residences and secure premises.

items.title: Fully insured
items.body: Professional liability insurance covers every intervention. [Insurer and cover to be confirmed.]

items.title: Supervised quality
items.body: Supervisors carry out regular quality visits and stay in direct contact with each client.

cta.title: Meet us in person
cta.body: The best way to know us is a consultation at your home or premises, without obligation.
